metadata.description: ModSmith: a Claude Code skill for building, pricing and vetting mods, plus ready-made mods you can install one by one.

plugins.name: modsmith
plugins.description: The ModSmith skill: ready-made mod patterns, per-turn token and prompt-cache review, vetting someone else's mod before installing, and rules for mods that work together.

plugins.name: modsmith-all
plugins.description: Installs the ModSmith skill and all six ModSmith mods in one go: quiz-after, next-steps-supervisor, assumption-ledger, mode-registry, effort-modes and artifact-dashboard. Remove any one later from /plugin.

plugins.name: quiz-after
plugins.description: After Claude finishes a task that changed something, shows 2-3 questions about what was built above the prompt. One cached fork on those turns only; /quiz turns it off.

plugins.name: next-steps-supervisor
plugins.description: After a turn that did real work, a cached side check asks whether the goal was met, where corners were cut and what needs your approval, with next steps as buttons. /supervisor turns it off.

plugins.name: assumption-ledger
plugins.description: Gives Claude a register_assumption tool and shows the turn's assumptions, decisions and considered-but-not-done items above the prompt. No model calls of its own.

plugins.name: mode-registry
plugins.description: One /mode switch any mod can add a mode to; the active mode shows in the prompt footer. No model calls.

plugins.name: effort-modes
plugins.description: Three modes on the /mode switch: ui (low effort), api (medium), review (max). Needs mode-registry. Each switch rebuilds the prompt cache once.

plugins.name: artifact-dashboard
plugins.description: A one-line summary of a shared Kanban artifact above the prompt, so several Claude sessions work from the same board. No model tokens.
